system.description: With this power you can transform into the spiritual form of any natural animal not larger than a bear and no smaller than a hummingbird, similar to the Protean power Shadow of the Beast. In this form you appear as a ghostly version of the animal, but are actually a solid creature that can attack and be wounded normally; the change alters only your body and normal clothes (other equipment, including weapons, is unchanged). To activate this power you must expend a Blood Trait; it takes one action to activate. You gain extra Physical Traits depending on the size of the creature: as a small creature (bird, bat), you gain Quick and Lithe; as a medium creature (wolf, dog), you gain Ferocious x2 and Vigorous; as a large creature (bear, tiger), you gain Ferocious, Rugged, Stalwart, and Tough.
